item.title: India central bank likely deploys FX swaps to mop up overseas deposit-driven liquidity, traders say
item.description: The Reserve Bank of India is likely conducting near-maturity dollar/rupee sell-buy swaps, as part of its recent efforts to absorb surplus rupee liquidity stemming from overseas deposits raised by lenders, bankers said.
item.dc:creator: Nimesh Vora, Jaspreet Kalra
item.content:encoded: The Reserve Bank of India is likely conducting near-maturity dollar/rupee sell-buy swaps, as part of its recent efforts to absorb surplus rupee liquidity stemming from overseas deposits raised by lenders, bankers said. The central bank is conducting the swaps with a maturity in September, four bankers and two FX brokers said, while two of four bankers said it was likely doing so for October maturity as well. Forward premiums for September and October rose in response, lifting premiums across tenors, according to the traders. The bankers, traders and brokers requested anonymity as they are not authorised to speak to the media. The RBI did not immediately respond to an email seeking comment. In a swap, the RBI sells dollars at the spot rate in exchange for rupees, effectively sucking liquidity out of the banking system. The transaction is reversed at maturity, which in this instance would be either September or October. Two other bankers estimated that the central bank had conducted swaps worth about $700 million across the two maturities. Indian lenders had proposed using FX sell-buy swaps for liquidity [USN:L4N44V0SC TEXT:"management"] at a recent meeting with the RBI. The RBI's move on Wednesday comes after its 30-day variable-rate reverse repo (VRRR) operation drew a [USN:L4N44Z0B2 TEXT:"weak"] response earlier this week. LIQUIDITY GLUT The banking system is saturated with rupee liquidity following a surge in dollar deposits raised by lenders from non-resident Indians and swapped with the RBI for rupees at zero cost. Gaura Sen Gupta, chief economist at IDFC FIRST Bank, estimated that core liquidity surplus has peaked at 14 trillion rupees to 15 trillion rupees ($147.26 billion-$157.78 billion). The RBI will aim to drain about 7 trillion rupees using VRRR operations and more durable instruments, she said, adding that sell-buy swaps are likely to be among the RBI's preferred options. Banks have raised about $128 billion through non-resident deposits, far exceeding initial expectations. "The RBI had to look at ways to manage the liquidity overhang and it looks like, for now, it has decided to use swaps, which buys it time for a few weeks," a senior treasury official at a mid-sized private sector bank said. Another benefit of sell-buy swaps is that they can help the RBI trim the size of its FX forward book, he added. The central bank's net forward dollar liabilities stood at about $137 billion at the end of July with $47.6 billion in the up to one year bucket. ($1 = 95.0700 Indian rupees)

item.title: Private investment a threat to Australian game, says NSW Cricket
item.description: Cricket New South Wales criticised Cricket Australia's decision to proceed with private investment in the Big Bash leagues on Wednesday, warning that the move could reduce funding for grassroots cricket and weaken the sport's long-term development.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Cricket New South Wales criticised Cricket Australia's decision to proceed with private investment in the Big Bash leagues on Wednesday, warning that the move could reduce funding for grassroots cricket and weaken the sport's long-term development. Cricket Australia [USN:L4N4500A9 TEXT:"announced"] on Tuesday that private investors would be introduced into the Big Bash League (BBL) from the 2027-28 season, beginning with the sale of the Melbourne Renegades Twenty20 franchise. While backing the continued growth of both the men's and women's BBL competitions, Cricket NSW said diverting profits to external investors risked reducing funds available for community cricket. "This decision risks leaving cricket in NSW and Australia strategically and financially worse off, with direct consequences for our ability to invest in grassroots cricket," Cricket NSW said in a statement. Cricket NSW said profits generated by its Sydney Sixers and Sydney Thunder franchises were reinvested into participation programmes, contributing to an 80% increase in participation among children aged five to 12 over the past four years. It added that one-third of Australia's contracted players came from NSW. "The redistribution of profits to external investors reduces our ability to invest in community cricket, creating long-term impacts at all levels," it said. Cricket NSW also expressed disappointment with the process leading to the decision, saying it had raised concerns with Cricket Australia. The board added that four conditions agreed by state association chairs in June before any sale process was undertaken had not been met. Despite its opposition, the organisation said it would continue working with Cricket Australia and other stakeholders to ensure the game's future. "We are proud to be part of an Australian cricket system that is the envy of the world. Cricket NSW will continue working with Cricket Australia... to ensure our game continues to thrive," it added.

item.title: Shelton elimina a Alcaraz tras un maratón nocturno y alcanza las semifinales del Abierto de EEUU
item.description: Ben Shelton venció al vigente campeón, Carlos Alcaraz, por 6-7(5), 6-1, 6-3, 1-6 y 7-6(10-7) en las primeras horas del miércoles, lo que le valió el pase a las semifinales del Abierto de Estados Unidos, en el partido que terminó más tarde en la historia del torneo.
item.dc:creator: Shrivathsa Sridhar
item.content:encoded: Ben Shelton venció al vigente campeón, Carlos Alcaraz, por 6-7(5), 6-1, 6-3, 1-6 y 7-6(10-7) en las primeras horas del miércoles, lo que le valió el pase a las semifinales del Abierto de Estados Unidos, en el partido que terminó más tarde en la historia del torneo. La victoria de Shelton le permite enfrentarse en semifinales a su compatriota Frances Tiafoe, lo que aviva las esperanzas de conseguir el primer campeón estadounidense de un Grand Slam masculino desde 2003. Alcaraz, siete veces campeón de Grand Slam, llegó al estadio Arthur Ashe con un récord de 13-0 en Grand Slam contra jugadores estadounidenses, pero le costó mucho superar a Shelton en un partido que comenzó a las 23:05 hora local del martes y terminó a las 3:33 horas del miércoles. "Para mí, lo importante siempre es el público", afirmó Shelton al explicar cómo logró superar ese agotador encuentro. "Ya sean mis entrenadores y mi equipo, toda mi familia y amigos aquí presentes, o la ciudad de Nueva York, que se ha volcado esta noche hasta las 3 de la madrugada con cánticos de 'USA' hasta el final." "Eso es lo que me ha dado fuerzas para seguir adelante y lo que me ha llevado a conseguir esta victoria esta noche." "Es increíble. Siempre digo que esta es la mejor ciudad deportiva del mundo. Digo que este es el mejor estadio del mundo." Alcaraz se llevó un reñido juego de desempate en el primer set y parecía tener todo a su favor, pero unos errores poco habituales permitieron a Shelton llevarse el siguiente set con facilidad, antes de que el estadounidense afianzara su ventaja en los cuartos de final al adjudicarse el tercero. El español, que regresaba a Nueva York tras casi cinco meses de baja por un problema en la muñeca, parecía falto de energía y cometió demasiados errores no forzados con su golpe de derecha, pero aun así logró forzar un set decisivo entre los vítores de los aficionados encantados. Alcaraz vomitó en una toalla durante el descanso, pero se enfrentó de tú a tú con Shelton durante 12 juegos antes de que su rival cerrara la sorprendente victoria tras cuatro horas y 28 minutos. "Espero que mi mejor amigo y mi hermana, que están ahí arriba, no tengan que ir a trabajar dentro de tres horas", añadió Shelton. "Sería un gran gesto por parte de sus jefes dejarles que se tomen el día libre hoy." "Estar aquí esta noche ante vosotros es un auténtico honor. Compartir la pista con Carlos es un auténtico honor, y disfruto cada momento que paso aquí."

item.title: American Rose leads Women’s ILCA 6 worlds as racing heats up
item.description: American Charlotte Rose leads the ILCA 6 Women’s World Championship on Wednesday as the 108-strong fleet splits into Gold and Silver divisions for the decisive phase of racing on Dublin Bay.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: American Charlotte Rose leads the ILCA 6 Women’s World Championship on Wednesday as the 108-strong fleet splits into Gold and Silver divisions for the decisive phase of racing on Dublin Bay. Rose, who sits two points clear of a field packed with Olympians after winning both races on Tuesday, said Gold Fleet racing amounts to a fresh start but would not alter her approach. • “Gold Fleet is a whole other game — basically the whole regatta starts over,” said Rose. “I don’t think anything really changes for me, though. I just go out there, do my routines, focus on the basics, keep fighting and never give up.” • Belgium’s twice world champion Emma Plasschaert lies second, with Denmark’s Anna Munch third overall, ahead of Australia’s Mara Stransky in fourth and Hungary’s former world number one Maria Erdi in fifth. • Wednesday’s racing is forecast in considerably lighter winds after two physically demanding opening days, with Tuesday’s breeze reaching 18 to 24 knots. • Ireland’s big LA2028 prospect Eve McMahon and 2016 Olympic silver medallist Annalise Murphy both qualified for Gold Fleet on home waters. • The championship, the first Women’s ILCA World Championship staged in Ireland, concludes on Saturday, when the top 10 will contest the Medal Series for the final podium positions.

item.title: MLB roundup: Brewers pull even in ninth inning, KO Cubs in 10th
item.description: Rookie Luis Lara's bases-loaded single in the 10th inning gave the Milwaukee Brewers a 4-3 comeback victory over the visiting Chicago Cubs on Tuesday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Rookie Luis Lara's bases-loaded single in the 10th inning gave the Milwaukee Brewers a 4-3 comeback victory over the visiting Chicago Cubs on Tuesday. Jackson Chourio, who finished 4-for-5, rescued the Brewers with a two-out, two-run homer in the ninth inning to tie it 3-3. DL Hall (3-0) threw 1 2/3 scoreless innings of relief for Milwaukee, which moved nine games ahead of the second-place Cubs. Jacob Misiorowski allowed one run on four hits in 6 1/3 innings. The Cubs squandered an opportunity in the top of the 10th when runner Seiya Suzuki was thrown out trying to advance to third on a fly ball to center fielder Garrett Mitchell. Jacob Webb served up Chourio's homer, and Caleb Thielbar (3-3) allowed Lara's decisive hit. Yankees 5, Rockies 3 Ryan McMahon lined a tiebreaking double with one out in the fifth inning against his former team, Cam Schlittler pitched seven strong innings, and host New York made Aaron Judge's return from the injured list a successful one with a victory over Colorado. After missing 84 games with a fractured right rib, Judge went 0-for-3 and did not make any plays while handling right field for six innings. Schlittler (13-6) allowed one run on three hits in seven innings, striking out 10 without a walk as New York earned its sixth win in nine games. Adael Amador hit a tying homer to open the third as the Rockies dropped their fifth straight road game. Gabriel Hughes (0-7) allowed two runs (one earned) on four hits in five innings. Rays 7, Braves 1 Freddy Peralta pitched six strong innings and visiting Tampa Bay hit four home runs en route to a victory over Atlanta in the opener of a three-game series featuring division leaders. The Rays won for the third time in four games to maintain a four-game edge over the New York Yankees in the American League East. Peralta (8-11) allowed one run on five hits. The Braves took their third loss in four games but remain four games ahead of the Philadelphia Phillies in the National League East. AJ Smith-Shawver (0-2) pitched 3 1/3 innings and gave up four runs on five hits. Guardians 9, Orioles 5 Travis Bazzana hit a three-run homer and Cleveland scored in four different innings to beat host Baltimore. Brayan Rocchio had two hits and knocked in two runs for the Guardians, who evened the three-game series by winning for the fourth time in their last six games. Angel Martinez, Petey Halpin and Patrick Bailey also provided two hits. Pete Alonso hit a two-run home run, but the Orioles couldn't dig out of a 6-0 hole. Baltimore lost for the seventh time in eight games. Twins 3, Tigers 2 Kody Clemens blasted a go-ahead, two-run homer in the sixth inning and visiting Minnesota held on for a victory over Detroit. Clemens' 25th homer of the season made a winner of Minnesota starter Dean Kremer (3-5), who allowed two runs and five hits in five innings. It was Kremer's second victory since he was acquired from Baltimore in a trade early last month. Josh Bell knocked in the other run for the Twins. Kevin McGonigle's two-run homer accounted for the Tigers' offense. Detroit starter Drew Anderson gave up three runs and four hits in 5 1/3 innings. Blue Jays 4, Athletics 2 Josh Smith and Kazuma Okamoto smacked back-to-back homers and Jose Soriano tossed seven strong innings to help Toronto record a victory over the Athletics in West Sacramento, Calif. Alejandro Kirk added an RBI single for the Blue Jays, who remain one game behind Cleveland for the third and final American League wild-card position. Smith, Okamoto and Vladimir Guerrero Jr. each had two hits for Toronto, which won for the eighth time in 11 games. Carlos Cortes and Donovan Walton homered for the Athletics, who had won five of their previous six games. Walton and Henry Bolte had two hits apiece. Dodgers 3, Reds 2 Tarik Skubal pitched into the eighth inning, Will Smith hit his first home run since May and Los Angeles increased its winning streak to six games with a victory over visiting Cincinnati. Teoscar Hernandez delivered a go-ahead single in the fifth inning for the Dodgers. Skubal (9-7) gave up two runs on four hits over 7 1/3 innings, and Tanner Scott pitched the ninth inning for his 22nd save. Elly De La Cruz hit a mammoth home run and threw out a runner at home plate from shallow center field but could not prevent the Reds from falling to 0-2 at the start of a six-game road trip. Nick Lodolo (3-4) gave up three runs on five hits over 4 2/3 innings. Astros 6, Phillies 5 Christian Walker hit an early three-run homer and visiting Houston held on for a victory over Philadelphia. Hayden Wesneski (5-1) allowed three runs and five hits over six innings for Houston. Daulton Varsho homered for the Astros as part of a 3-for-5 night, while Cam Smith also went deep. Walker finished with two hits, as did Yainer Diaz. The Phillies rallied from a 5-0 deficit to get within 6-5 on Edmundo Sosa's ninth-inning RBI double against Josh Hader. Andrew Painter (3-9) was charged with five runs and 10 hits in five frames. Trea Turner registered two hits, including a homer. Pirates 9, White Sox 3 Spencer Horwitz had two hits and drove in three runs, including an RBI single in a five-run first inning, and Bubba Chandler pitched six sharp innings as visiting Pittsburgh routed Chicago. Every starter had at least one hit for the Pirates, who won for the seventh time in nine games. Oneil Cruz and Rafael Flores Jr. paced Pittsburgh's 18-hit attack with three hits apiece. Chandler (7-9) yielded two runs on four hits. Andrew Benintendi and Kyle Teel both had two hits for the White Sox, who have lost four of six. Sean Burke (8-7) was hammered for seven runs on eight hits in 1 1/3 innings. Diamondbacks 5, Royals 3 (11 innings) Lourdes Gurriel Jr. tripled to drive in the go-ahead run in the 11th, Ketel Marte capped a two-run inning with a sacrifice fly, and Arizona extended its winning streak to four with a victory at Kansas City. Tim Tawa socked a solo homer in the ninth to give the Diamondbacks a 2-0 lead, but John Rave hit a two-out, two-run homer off Juan Morillo to tie it at 2-2. Each team scored a run in the 10th before Arizona won it off Anthony Gose (1-1) in the 11th. Diamondbacks reliever Blake Walston (1-0) left the bases loaded in the 10th and retired all three batters he faced in the 11th. Arizona starter Corbin Burnes tossed three scoreless innings in his season debut. Mets 7, Marlins 5 Francisco Lindor, Juan Soto and Brett Baty homered off Marlins ace Sandy Alcantara as New York defeated host Miami for its fifth victory in six games. Mets starter Sean Manaea (5-7) was perfect through five innings but wound up allowing five hits and four runs without getting an out in the sixth. Kodai Senga yielded a run in the ninth but still earned his seventh save in seven tries. Alcantara (13-10) gave up seven hits and seven runs in 4 1/3 innings. Jakob Marsee had three hits and an RBI for the Marlins, who lost for the fifth time in six games. Padres 5, Nationals 4 Luis Campusano's two-out RBI single in the bottom of the eighth inning capped a four-run rally that lifted San Diego to a win over visiting Washington. Campusano knocked in Manny Machado, whose two-run single off Erik Tolman (0-1) tied the game at 4. Padres reliever David Morgan (3-1) got one out on one pitch, and Adrian Morejon garnered his third save with a 1-2-3 ninth. Andres Chaparro and Yohandy Morales hit solo homers for the Nationals. Erik Tolman (0-1) entered in the eighth with a 4-1 lead but let in three inherited runners and had one charged to him. Angels 6, Red Sox 1 Reid Detmers pitched six scoreless innings and Zach Neto hit a two-run homer to help visiting Los Angeles end Boston's five-game winning streak. Detmers (5-8) allowed just one hit, a first-inning single by Wilyer Abreu. He struck out nine and walked one. Neto went 4-for-5 as the Angels got just their third win in 15 games. Red Sox starter Patrick Sandoval (1-5) allowed four runs on 10 hits in six innings. Nick Sogard collected two of Boston's four hits and had the team's lone RBI. Rangers 10, Mariners 5 Corey Seager, Wyatt Langford and Danny Jansen hit home runs as Texas routed host Seattle. Cal Quantrill (8-5) pitched six innings to win for the fourth time in his past five starts. He allowed three runs on five hits as the Rangers won their second in a row. The Mariners have lost four of the first five games on their seven-game homestand. The primary highlight for Seattle was a tape-measure home run by rookie Lazaro Montes in the fourth inning. Bryce Miller (4-9) surrendered four runs in 3 2/3 innings. Giants 2, Cardinals 1 Landen Roupp threw six shutout innings, Bryce Eldridge and Christian Koss smacked home runs and San Francisco beat visiting St. Louis for the second day in a row. Reiver Sanmartin, Carson Seymour and Joel Kuhnel (seventh save) combined with Roupp (9-13) on a five-hitter. Koss had two hits for the Giants, who will shoot for their first home series sweep of the season Wednesday afternoon when the three-game set concludes. Cardinals starter Quinn Mathews (1-3) completed six innings, limiting the Giants to two runs on five hits. Bryan Torres singled home a run in the ninth. --Field Level Media

item.title: Irã ataca base dos EUA na Jordânia e navios próximos ao Estreito de Ormuz após naufrágio de petroleiros
item.description: A Guarda Revolucionária do Irã afirmou ter disparado mísseis balísticos contra uma base na Jordânia utilizada pelas Forças Armadas dos EUA e ter atacado 10 navios nesta quarta-feira, depois que os EUA anunciaram ter destruído cinco petroleiros iranianos, em uma forte escalada do conflito que já dura seis meses.
item.dc:creator: Enas Alashray, Idrees Ali
item.content:encoded: A Guarda Revolucionária do Irã afirmou ter disparado mísseis balísticos contra uma base na Jordânia utilizada pelas Forças Armadas dos EUA e ter atacado 10 navios nesta quarta-feira, depois que os EUA anunciaram ter destruído cinco petroleiros iranianos, em uma forte escalada do conflito que já dura seis meses. O aumento dos ataques tanto por parte dos EUA quanto do Irã abalou um mês de relativa calma, atingindo alvos militares, navios e instalações do setor energético, fazendo os preços do petróleo dispararem e envolvendo aliados regionais nos últimos dias. Os norte-americanos afirmaram ter destruído cinco petroleiros iranianos na terça-feira. O Comando Central das Forças Armadas dos EUA divulgou um vídeo dos ataques, que classificou como uma resposta à Guarda Revolucionária Islâmica do Irã, que havia atacado duas vezes um navio de guerra da Marinha dos EUA com mísseis balísticos nos dois dias anteriores. Nenhum norte-americano ficou ferido, informaram as autoridades americanas. "O Irã continua tentando atacar navios da Marinha dos EUA e, cada vez que fizerem isso ou tentarem fazer isso, perderão petroleiros", disse o secretário de Estado dos EUA, Marco Rubio, a repórteres durante uma visita à Colômbia. O Irã então realizou um ataque com mísseis balísticos contra uma base usada pelas forças americanas perto de Al Azraq, na Jordânia, de acordo com um comunicado da Guarda divulgado pela mídia estatal. Embora o Irã tenha afirmado que seus mísseis causaram danos graves, a Jordânia informou que suas defesas aéreas interceptaram 18 dos 20 mísseis iranianos, com dois caindo em áreas despovoadas, e que não houve vítimas. Uma autoridade norte-americana afirmou que os ataques do Irã na Jordânia foram ineficazes e que todas as tropas americanas foram localizadas. A Guarda Revolucionária Islâmica do Irã informou na quarta-feira que também atacou 10 navios, incluindo duas embarcações americanas e oito petroleiros, que tentavam atravessar uma área "proibida e insegura" do Estreito de Ormuz, um importante corredor energético amplamente bloqueado pelos ataques iranianos. O Irã tem atacado alvos dos EUA e de seus aliados na região ao longo da guerra, inclusive na Jordânia em várias ocasiões, matando pelo menos dois militares norte-americanos durante um ataque em julho. O Irã também ameaçou petroleiros nos portos do Kuwait e do Barein, de acordo com um comunicado divulgado pela mídia estatal. Uma fonte de segurança marítima informou que um navio-tanque de gás natural liquefeito foi danificado no porto de Khor Fakkan, nos Emirados Árabes Unidos, embora não estivesse claro quem fosse o responsável. (Reportagem de Enas Alashray e Idrees Ali)

item.title: EUA proíbem importações de motocicletas, laticínios e bebidas do Canadá, enquanto guerra comercial se intensifica
item.description: Os Estados Unidos proibiram na terça-feira a importação de uma ampla gama de bebidas alcoólicas, motocicletas e laticínios canadenses, intensificando drasticamente uma disputa comercial já bastante acirrada.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Os Estados Unidos proibiram na terça-feira a importação de uma ampla gama de bebidas alcoólicas, motocicletas e laticínios canadenses, intensificando drasticamente uma disputa comercial já bastante acirrada. As proibições de importação, que entram em vigor em 29 de setembro e foram publicadas no site da Casa Branca, ocorreram depois que as próprias tarifas retaliatórias do Canadá sobre produtos norte-americanos entraram em vigor após a meia-noite desta terça-feira. Essas tarifas canadenses, por sua vez, vieram em resposta às tarifas de 50% que os Estados Unidos impuseram a cerca de US$20 bilhões em produtos canadenses no mês passado, após o fracasso de várias rodadas de negociações. O impasse ampliou a divisão entre os aliados de longa data, que se culparam mutuamente pelo fracasso das negociações, levou o primeiro-ministro canadense Mark Carney a pedir um afastamento ainda maior do maior parceiro comercial do Canadá e lançou dúvidas sobre a viabilidade do Acordo EUA-México-Canadá. “Temos tudo o que precisamos para mudar de rumo e prosperar”, disse Carney na terça-feira em um vídeo publicado no YouTube. “Essa reorientação terá um custo. Sempre há um custo para agir. Mas não chega nem perto do custo de ficar parado”, disse ele. As proibições dos EUA parecem abranger a maioria dos produtos alcoólicos, incluindo cerveja e vários tipos de vinho, uísque, bourbon, rum, vodca, vermute, tequila, mezcal e conhaque. A proibição de laticínios abrange proteína de soro de leite, melaço invertido, melaço de cana e cerveja sem álcool, conforme comunicados no site da Casa Branca. Além das proibições de importação, vários produtos de queijo foram adicionados a uma lista de produtos sujeitos a uma tarifa de 50%, mas não foram totalmente proibidos. Alguns produtos de papel, alumínio, madeira, móveis, iluminação e outros também foram adicionados à lista. Uma autoridade norte-americana afirmou que a ameaça pré-existente do presidente Donald Trump de aumentar as tarifas sobre automóveis canadenses de 25% para 50% a partir de 1º de janeiro continuava em vigor. A autoridade acrescentou que o representante comercial dos EUA, Jamieson Greer, havia conversado com Dominic LeBlanc, ministro canadense responsável pelo comércio bilateral com os EUA, nos últimos dois dias, e que os dois deveriam se falar novamente nos próximos dias para verificar se havia um caminho alternativo para os dois países. Em uma postagem nas redes sociais na noite de terça-feira, LeBlanc criticou as últimas medidas dos EUA e disse que estava em contato com Greer a respeito de um caminho a seguir. “Assim como tem sido nos últimos 18 meses, nossa principal prioridade continua sendo proteger e apoiar os trabalhadores, agricultores, famílias e empresas canadenses contra essas ações injustificadas”, escreveu ele. OTTAWA RESPONDE As medidas retaliatórias de Ottawa, que por sua vez provocaram a reação de Washington na noite de terça-feira, foram concebidas para exercer pressão econômica e política sobre Washington, afirmaram autoridades do governo canadense. Essas tarifas de retaliação abrangem cerca de US$20 bilhões em produtos norte-americanos, com alíquotas que variam de 15% a 50% em itens que vão do aço e móveis até roupas e eletrônicos, e devem afetar setores em alguns estados competitivos, como Michigan e Ohio, antes das eleições de meio de mandato nos EUA em novembro. Embora as tarifas afetem uma pequena parcela das exportações em comparação com o comércio total entre os EUA e o Canadá, alguns analistas temem que o impasse possa desestabilizar o Acordo EUA-México-Canadá, o pacto de livre comércio que sucedeu o NAFTA. Juntos, eles têm sustentado o comércio em toda a América do Norte há décadas. “O que nos preocupa é uma espiral de escalada”, disse Michael Harvey, diretor executivo da Aliança Canadense de Comércio Agroalimentar e membro do comitê consultivo de Carney sobre relações econômicas bilaterais com os EUA. “Mas, ao mesmo tempo, entendemos perfeitamente que o primeiro-ministro precisa encontrar áreas de influência.” Trump vem lançando vários ataques contra o Canadá no Truth Social nos últimos dias. Na segunda-feira, ele afirmou que a fabricante canadense de jatos particulares Bombardier (BBDb.TO) não teria mais permissão para vender suas aeronaves nos Estados Unidos, a menos que começasse a fabricar no país. Ele também compartilhou um mapa da América do Norte coberto pela bandeira dos EUA, incluindo o Canadá e o México, e uma imagem gerada por IA que retoma uma provocação recorrente a Carney, chamando-o de “Governador” — uma referência à sua provocação repetida de que o Canadá deveria se tornar o 51º estado dos EUA. Na terça-feira, horas antes das últimas proibições de importação, Trump instruiu a Administração de Serviços Gerais (GSA na sigla em inglês), órgão do governo dos EUA responsável por prestar serviços ao governo federal, a coordenar-se com o Representante de Comércio dos EUA e “REMOVER os produtos de origem canadense das Listas de Contratação Múltipla da GSA, a menos que o Canadá restabeleça a reciprocidade plena e justa para os agricultores e empresas americanas”. (Reportagem de Promit Mukherjee em Ottawa e de Gram Slattery e Ryan Jones em Washington)

item.title: Amid NFL hoopla, flag football makes quieter push in suburban Australia
item.description: The National Football League (NFL) is determined to make a big splash at its first regular-season game in Australia but out in the Melbourne suburbs, a quieter revolution is brewing without the helmets, shoulder pads and big hits.
item.dc:creator: Ian Ransom
item.content:encoded: The National Football League (NFL) is determined to make a big splash at its first regular-season game in Australia but out in the Melbourne suburbs, a quieter revolution is brewing without the helmets, shoulder pads and big hits. Non-contact flag football, which will make its Olympic debut at the 2028 Los Angeles Games, may be the NFL's best chance of turning American football from a TV product into a genuine participation sport outside the United States. As the San Francisco 49ers and Los Angeles Rams prepare for their season-opener at the 100,000-seat Melbourne Cricket Ground, NFL officials and former players have been visiting schools and running clinics in Melbourne to preach the virtues of flag in a market that loves team sports. Former Rams wide receiver Torry Holt, a seven-times Pro Bowl player, took students through an introductory session of flag at Balwyn High school in Melbourne's eastern suburbs, giving notes on how ball-carriers can develop evasive skills. “Flag football is so inclusive; everybody can play it. Girls, boys, little kids, little girls -- everybody," Holt told Reuters. "It's not as expensive to play because you don't need all the gear. So I'm super excited about where flag football is and the States are excited about what it could be internationally." OLYMPIC DREAMS A commercial behemoth, the NFL is convinced its biggest growth will come from non-U.S. markets and that flag can be the key to unlocking them. It lobbied hard to get flag at the LA Games and has invested heavily in developing it at grassroots level in strategic foreign markets like Australia. The league says flag is now played in more than 500 schools around the country. The idea is to get children playing flag first and worry about converting them into NFL fans later. “People don't inherently play (American) football,” Gerrit Meier, the head of NFL International, told Reuters. “So we need to create a relevance that goes way beyond the NFL.” That means accepting there will be no quick commercial returns from investment and instead measuring success as a participation game. “If suddenly I can get the education minister to say, ‘You know what? We should put flag into the school system,’ and we have more boys and girls playing it in school -- there's no commercial return but it's definitely on my list of what constitutes winning in that market.” While the LA Games will give flag's profile a huge boost, keeping it relevant may be a challenge without a guaranteed spot on the Olympic programme. Flag was approved specifically for Los Angeles but will need to fight to retain its spot on the 2032 Brisbane Olympics programme along with squash, cricket and other sports. Flag football officials have made their pitch to 2032 Games organisers, whose programme choices must be signed off by the International Olympic Committee before they are confirmed likely later this year. NFL teams have backed flag and more than 200 NFL players are interested in playing it at the Olympics, the league said last month. Flag's 2032 fate will be decided before LA 2028, but the prospect of NFL stardust sprinkled over the Olympics on an ongoing basis may not hurt its chances of retention. Meier said players on multi-million dollar contracts could not help but be attracted by the "carrot" of an Olympic gold medal. "You've seen it in basketball, you've seen it in tennis. It is very meaningful to be part of the Olympic movement," he said.

item.title: Dutch public transport halted by strike against welfare cuts
item.description: Public transport in the Netherlands was halted on Wednesday by a nationwide strike against government proposals to cut welfare spending.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Public transport in the Netherlands was halted on Wednesday by a nationwide strike against government proposals to cut welfare spending. Almost no trains, buses or ferries operated throughout the country because of the 24-hour strike, which also affected international train services to Belgium, Germany, France and Britain. Labour unions organised the strike against government plans to cut up to €6.5 billion ($7.6 billion) in annual welfare spending, mainly by limiting unemployment benefits, to fund a large increase in defence spending. The strike adds to the difficulties the centre-right minority government, installed this year, already has in getting proposals approved in both houses of parliament. Lacking a majority, the coalition needs outside support. But the opposition-leading, left-wing Pro party has sided with the unions in their demand that all proposals to cut welfare spending should be taken off the table. In an effort to gain support, the government has already dropped a plan to raise the retirement age and last week agreed to soften other proposals. But the Pro party has said this was likely not enough, setting the stage for further negotiations after the official presentation of the government budget on September 15. ($1 = 0.8595 euros)

item.title: Silicon Valley-backed Covenant unveils low-cost, mass-producible cruise missile
item.description: Defense startup Covenant on Wednesday unveiled a heavy-payload, long-range cruise missile it says can be quickly mass-produced at a relatively low cost, in the latest challenge to major U.S. weapons makers from some of Silicon Valley's biggest investors.
item.dc:creator: Mike Stone
item.content:encoded: Defense startup Covenant on Wednesday unveiled a heavy-payload, long-range cruise missile it says can be quickly mass-produced at a relatively low cost, in the latest challenge to major U.S. weapons makers from some of Silicon Valley's biggest investors. The announcement from Covenant after two years of development coincides with efforts by the U.S. and its allies to restock missile inventories with less expensive and plentiful long-range precision-strike missiles after the war in Iran [USN:L1N43W1IH TEXT:"depleted stocks"] of the critical armaments. Its missile, called Anthem, is a ground-launched cruise missile carrying a payload of more than 200 kg (441 pounds). In a fight, it would be used in high volumes to work alongside other long-range missiles like the 1,000-mile (1,609-km) range Tomahawk cruise missile produced by RTX's (RTX.N) Raytheon unit and the 600-mile Lockheed Martin (LMT.N) Joint Air-to-Surface Standoff Missile-Extended Range (JASSM-ER). Comparable weapons from the biggest defense contractors are "being built in small quantities at really high prices. And so we set out to change that," Michael Kaufman, Covenant's co-founder and CEO, told Reuters in an interview. The company, founded in 2024, has raised just over $250 million from investors including Andreessen Horowitz, Founders Fund, Lux, 8VC, Aleph and Lightspeed, and now employs more than 200 people across the U.S., Germany and Israel. Anthem is powered by a solid rocket motor for takeoff and a heavy-fuel jet engine for cruise flight. Covenant says it has flown the missile more than 200 times over the past year in tests. Executives said the missile was built with an eye toward the Pacific. "We were designed for the China fight," said Covenant President Abby Denburg. Military planners envision using ground-launched weapons designed to strike from allied islands near China, [USN:L6N41F013 TEXT:"such as the Philippines"] — a stretch of roughly 2,000 miles that would put Chinese targets within range without relying on manned aircraft or naval strike groups. Covenant is targeting a mid-six-figure price per missile once at full-rate production. The company has already booked roughly $150 million in orders and expects to begin generating revenue in 2027 as deliveries ramp up. An international customer is due to begin taking delivery of German-built Anthems by the end of this year, with U.S. Army deliveries expected in 2027, executives said. New defense companies often struggle to gain traction as they take on vested interests with new technologies and can run into significant hurdles delivering their products, especially in big quantities. Covenant said it deliberately avoided sole-source suppliers, lining up three solid-rocket-motor providers with a fourth in the works, and locking in long-term agreements for more than 4,000 jet engines over the next two years. The company's Dallas plant, spanning 105,000 square feet (9,754 square meters), opens on Wednesday and is expected to reach full-rate production of 5,000 missiles a year. Covenant operates a similar-sized facility in Saxony, Germany, which will also have a 5,000-unit-per-year capacity. A smaller site in northern Israel will make 2,000 units a year.

item.title: Landslide hits Japan's Mount Fuji after heavy rain
item.description: A landslide struck one of the main starting points for climbers on Japan's Mount Fuji on Wednesday, local broadcaster TBS reported, after heavy rain inundated large parts of the country's centre.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: A landslide struck one of the main starting points for climbers on Japan's Mount Fuji on Wednesday, local broadcaster TBS reported, after heavy rain inundated large parts of the country's centre. Three vehicles were covered by the debris but no injuries or casualties have been reported, the broadcaster said. The incident followed heavy rain in the mountainous areas of Shizuoka Prefecture overnight and into Wednesday morning, the Japan Meteorological Agency said. The Fuji Subaru Line, one of the main access roads to Mount Fuji, was closed due to heavy rain, according to its website. Separately, two climbers were found unconscious on trails on Mount Fuji early Wednesday, Kyodo News reported, citing Shizuoka prefectural police, who have not connected the incident to the landslide. A police mountain rescue team has been dispatched to the scene, Kyodo added. Another landslide struck the town of Kawanehon in Shizuoka Prefecture on Tuesday night, and a worker who had been left unconscious was later confirmed dead, local authorities said. Torrential rain also battered the nearby central Japanese prefectures of Aichi and Gifu on Tuesday evening, causing flooding in some areas and injuring 41 people, Kyodo reported. Nagoya, the capital of Aichi Prefecture, recorded a record 104.5 mm of rainfall in a single hour on Tuesday evening, according to public broadcaster NHK. Long queues of stranded commuters formed at stations in central Nagoya after heavy rain disrupted transportation services, NHK reported. Heavy rain is expected to continue through Wednesday afternoon from northeastern to western Japan, according to the meteorological agency.

item.title: Israel to open embassy in Slovenia as relations thaw
item.description: The rapprochement comes as Israel faces growing diplomatic isolation elsewhere.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Israel will open its first embassy in Slovenia on Wednesday in a sign of warming relations after [USN:L6N42C0VW TEXT:"populist Janez Jansa"] formed a centre-right government following elections in March. The rapprochement comes as Israel faces growing diplomatic isolation elsewhere over its policy in the West Bank including [USN:S8N42N05Y TEXT:"import bans"] from Britain, France and Canada on products from Israeli settlements. "Since taking office, Prime Minister Jansa and his new government in Slovenia have demonstrated their friendship toward Israel through both words and actions, and have expressed support for Israel within the European Union," the Israeli Foreign Ministry said in a statement. The move is not universally popular in Slovenia. Protests were scheduled against the opening of the embassy on Wednesday evening by student movements, a left-wing political opposition party and pro-Palestinian groups. Israeli Foreign Minister Gideon Saar was due to arrive in Slovenia on Wednesday for a two-day visit during which he will meet his Slovenian counterpart Tone Kajzer and sign a memorandum on cultural cooperation. He will also lead a delegation of Israeli businessmen aiming to strengthen economic cooperation. It marks a sudden turnaround for Slovenia, a tiny Alpine country which is a European Union and NATO military alliance member. Under the previous government of liberal Robert Golob, it was one of a few European countries to recognise a Palestinian state. Slovenia was also among the first EU countries that banned imports from the West Bank and entry for Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and his two hardline ministers, decisions that were quickly revoked by the new government. Israel was among the first countries to recognise Slovenia’s independence and diplomatic relations were established in 1992. Slovenia opened an embassy in Israel in 1994, while Israel had until now been represented by a non-resident ambassador.

item.title: Las emisiones de Indonesia superan las de Rusia por los incendios y marcan un récord mundial
item.description: Indonesia se enfrenta a un aumento de las emisiones provocadas por los incendios que están quemando grandes extensiones de bosques y turberas resecas en las islas de Borneo y Sumatra, con niveles de dióxido de carbono que actualmente son los más altos del mundo, según datos publicados este miércoles.
item.dc:creator: David Stanway, Fransiska Nangoy
item.content:encoded: Indonesia se enfrenta a un aumento de las emisiones provocadas por los incendios que están quemando grandes extensiones de bosques y turberas resecas en las islas de Borneo y Sumatra, con niveles de dióxido de carbono que actualmente son los más altos del mundo, según datos publicados este miércoles. Las emisiones de los incendios en Indonesia entre el 1 y el 7 de septiembre alcanzaron los 19,7 millones de toneladas métricas, superando a Rusia esta semana y representando más de un tercio del total mundial, según Fire Emissions Watch, un portal desarrollado por el servicio de vigilancia climática Copernicus de la Unión Europea. Indonesia es uno de los países más propensos a los incendios del mundo, pero a medida que las condiciones meteorológicas de un fenómeno El Niño excepcional elevan las temperaturas y provocan sequías devastadoras, el país se enfrenta a la temporada de incendios más intensa en 11 años, según las autoridades. "Es normal que se produzcan algunos incendios en la región en esta época del año, pero, con El Niño, está claro que su intensidad se ve considerablemente aumentada", dijo Mark Parrington, científico del Servicio de Vigilancia de la Atmósfera de Copernicus, con sede en Bonn. "El clima es mucho más seco, hace más calor y, cuando se produce la ignición, estos incendios arden de una forma mucho más extrema". Entre el 1 y el 7 de septiembre, la intensidad de las emisiones de los incendios superó los 1.500 kg/km², más de diez veces el nivel registrado en Rusia, con las concentraciones más altas en Kalimantan —en la parte indonesia de Borneo— y en el este de Sumatra, mostraron el miércoles los datos de Copernicus. Las emisiones fueron un 273% superiores a la media estacional, aunque siguen siendo inferiores a los 21,7 millones de toneladas emitidas en la misma semana de 2015, cuando Indonesia se enfrentaba a condiciones de El Niño de similar intensidad. Entre las zonas más afectadas se encuentra la ciudad de Pontianak, en Kalimantan Occidental, donde el índice de calidad del aire era de 394 el miércoles, según la empresa suiza de monitorización de la calidad del aire IQAir. Un valor de 300 se considera peligroso. El Ministerio de Medio Ambiente de Indonesia dijo a Reuters en un comunicado que observaba "con preocupación" los índices peligrosos de calidad del aire en Kalimantan y en otros lugares. El ministerio dijo que estaba supervisando los datos de Copernicus, pero añadió que "no reflejan directamente las condiciones de la calidad del aire en una zona concreta" y que era necesario tener en cuenta otros factores. "POR DEBAJO DEL LÍMITE DE DETECCIÓN" De enero a julio de este año, los incendios arrasaron unas 202.000 hectáreas de territorio indonesio, aproximadamente un tercio de la superficie afectada durante el mismo periodo de 2015, según Nisa Novita, del grupo ecologista YKAN, que ayuda a las comunidades a combatir los incendios. "Sin embargo, se estima que los datos de agosto mostrarán un aumento significativo de unas 600.000 hectáreas, especialmente en Kalimantan, Sumatra y Papúa del Sur", dijo. Indonesia sufrió incendios en un total de 2,6 millones de hectáreas en todo el año 2015, una superficie mayor que la de Gales. El número de focos de incendio registrados entre el 1 de agosto y el 8 de septiembre ascendió a 13.443, frente a los 9.454 del mismo periodo de 2015, según la plataforma de seguimiento Sipongi del Ministerio de Bosques de Indonesia, basada en datos de los satélites Terra y Aqua de la NASA. En octubre de 2015 se registró un máximo histórico mensual de focos de incendio, según los datos de Sipongi. Fire Emissions Watch utiliza observaciones satelitales para estimar las concentraciones de partículas en suspensión, compuestos orgánicos volátiles, gases de efecto invernadero y otros contaminantes generados por los incendios, pero Parrington señaló que, en realidad, podría estar subestimando la magnitud del problema. "Uno de los aspectos de los incendios de turba es que, si arden a bajas temperaturas o bajo tierra, quedarían por debajo del límite de detección de los sensores, lo que significa que, en realidad, no los estamos viendo", explicó. Los estudios han demostrado que los incendios en Indonesia en 2015 produjeron más emisiones diarias que toda la UE y causaron 100.000 muertes más de lo habitual en Indonesia, Malasia y Singapur. "Debemos recordar que aún estamos al principio de la temporada, y esperamos que los incendios continúen y que las emisiones sigan aumentando, posiblemente hasta finales de octubre, que es lo que observamos en 2015", señaló Parrington. "Dentro de dos meses sabremos hasta qué punto ha sido extremo este año, pero los primeros indicios apuntan a que va al mismo ritmo, si no ligeramente por encima, de los años anteriores en los que se produjo el fenómeno de El Niño".

item.title: Hyrox founders reclaim majority stake in fitness-racing group with L Catterton-led investors
item.description: Co-founders of Hyrox, the fitness-racing group whose gruelling course is popular on social media, bought back Infront Sports & Media's majority stake in the company in partnership with a consortium led by U.S. private equity firm L Catterton, the German firm said on Tuesday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Co-founders of Hyrox, the fitness-racing group whose gruelling course is popular on social media, bought back Infront Sports & Media's majority stake in the company in partnership with a consortium led by U.S. private equity firm L Catterton, the German firm said on Tuesday. While Hyrox and Swiss firm Infront did not disclose financial details, several media outlets reported the deal valued the company at €600 million ($698.28 million). L Catterton did not respond to a Reuters request for comment. Hamburg-based Hyrox's standardised indoor fitness race, combining running and functional workouts, has grown rapidly from a niche fitness challenge into a global phenomenon since it was founded in 2017. The competition is divided into eight segments, each consisting of a 1-kilometre run followed by a fitness exercise. The company also operates events, training programmes and affiliate gyms in more than 30 countries. Infront, which first invested in the business in 2019 and became its majority owner in 2022, said Hyrox had expanded to more than 100 events, attracting over 1.4 million participants and more than 1.5 million spectators during the 2025-26 season. "This acquisition marks a pivotal next step in the rapid evolution of the Hyrox success story," Hyrox co-founder Moritz Fuerste, a double Olympic hockey gold medallist for Germany, said in a statement. The fast-growing sport has also set its [USN:L4N44E02K TEXT:"sights on the Olympics"], with Hyrox India head Deepak Raj telling Reuters in August that the organisation was aiming for a place in the 2032 and 2036 Games. ($1 = €0.8593)

item.title: SPD-Fraktionschef: Koalition muss bei Reformen mehr auf Gerechtigkeitsfragen achten
item.description: SPD-Fraktionschef Matthias Miersch hat die schwarz-rote Koalition aufgefordert, bei den anstehenden Reformen mehr auf Gerechtigkeitsfragen zu achten. In der Generaldebatte über den Haushalt 2027 nannte er im Bundestag am Mittwoch dabei etwa die Renten- und Krankenversicherung. Miersch verteidigte, dass auch Kürzungen in den Sozialsystemen nötig seien, um Beitragssteigerungen zu verhindern. Bei dem anstehenden Rentenpaket gehe es nicht nur um die abschlagsfreie Rente nach 45 Beitragsjahren. "Es geht um Sicherheit." Die Rentenkommission habe auch vorgeschlagen, dass möglichst alle Berufsgruppen in ein künftiges Rentensystem einzahlen.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: SPD-Fraktionschef Matthias Miersch hat die schwarz-rote Koalition aufgefordert, bei den anstehenden Reformen mehr auf Gerechtigkeitsfragen zu achten. In der Generaldebatte über den Haushalt 2027 nannte er im Bundestag am Mittwoch dabei etwa die Renten- und Krankenversicherung. Miersch verteidigte, dass auch Kürzungen in den Sozialsystemen nötig seien, um Beitragssteigerungen zu verhindern. Bei dem anstehenden Rentenpaket gehe es nicht nur um die abschlagsfreie Rente nach 45 Beitragsjahren. "Es geht um Sicherheit." Die Rentenkommission habe auch vorgeschlagen, dass möglichst alle Berufsgruppen in ein künftiges Rentensystem einzahlen. Bei der Reform der Krankenversicherung habe man bisher auch vor allem auf Einsparungen geschaut, sagte Miersch. "Wir brauchen jetzt strukturelle Veränderungen", fügte er hinzu. Als Beispiel nannte er, dass ein gesetzlich Versicherter denselben Anspruch auf einen Facharzttermin haben müsse wie ein Privatversicherter. Damit würde man endlich die Ungleichheit beseitigen.

item.title: India August consumer inflation likely hit 20-month high on food, fuel prices: Reuters poll
item.description: India's consumer inflation likely rose to a 20-month high in August, driven by higher food and fuel prices, marking a third straight month above the Reserve Bank of India's 4% medium-term target, a Reuters poll of economists showed.
item.dc:creator: Pranoy Krishna
item.content:encoded: India's consumer inflation likely rose to a 20-month high in August, driven by higher food and fuel prices, marking a third straight month above the Reserve Bank of India's 4% medium-term target, a Reuters poll of economists showed. Annual consumer price inflation, based on the consumer price index (CPI), was forecast to rise to 4.80% in August from 4.45% in July, according to the September 3 to 9 Reuters poll of 44 economists. Forecasts for the data, due on September 14, ranged from 4.40% to 5.05%. With inflation remaining within the RBI's 2%-6% target band, the central bank [USN:L1N442056 TEXT:"held"] interest rates last month, although [USN:L4N44G112 TEXT:"minutes"] of its latest meeting signalled it was prepared to tighten policy if price pressures broadened. It is not expected to raise rates until next year. An [USN:L4N44L0OX TEXT:"erratic monsoon"] disrupted food supplies, driving up prices of essentials such as sugar, cereals, milk, edible oils, eggs and meat. Global crude prices , now [USN:L1N45100H TEXT:"nearing"] $100 a barrel, and higher cooking gas prices also fueled inflation pressures. "The increase is expected to be primarily driven by elevated food prices together with a further rise in fuel inflation," said Kanika Pasricha, chief economic adviser at Union Bank of India. Persistent year-on-year declines in potato and pea prices continued to offset increases in other food items, limiting the rise in headline inflation. Sugar prices hit a [USN:L4N4421MB TEXT:"record high"] in August and likely added at least 15 basis points to headline inflation, Pasricha said. India's [USN:L1N41Q11J TEXT:"ban"] on sugar exports to cool domestic prices, which began in May, will stay in place until end- September. Core inflation, which excludes volatile food and fuel components and is seen as a gauge of underlying demand pressures, was expected to rise to 4.1% in August. India does not publish an official core inflation measure. Wholesale price inflation (INWPI=ECI) is also forecast to edge up to 9.89% in August from 9.78% in July, the survey showed, hovering around 10% for a fourth straight month. A separate Reuters poll conducted last month showed the RBI was expected to raise rates by 25 basis points in the second quarter of 2027, followed by a further increase in the fourth quarter, taking the policy rate to 5.75%.

item.title: Banche, crescita prestiti a imprese accelera a luglio - Bankitalia
item.description: A luglio la crescita dei prestiti concessi dalle banche italiane alle società non finanziarie ha registrato un'accelerazione rispetto al mese precedente.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: A luglio la crescita dei prestiti concessi dalle banche italiane alle società non finanziarie ha registrato un'accelerazione rispetto al mese precedente. E' quanto emerge dai dati della Banca d'Italia contenuti nel documento "Moneta e banche" diffuso oggi. Nel mese in esame l'aumento tendenziale dei prestiti alle imprese è pari al 4,1% rispetto al 3,2% di giugno. I dati di Bankitalia mostrano inoltre che a luglio i depositi dei residenti presso le banche italiane sono aumentati del 2,4% su anno dopo il +2,8% del mese precedente. Rallenta anche la crescita della raccolta obbligazionaria, aumentata del 5,6% rispetto al +6,0 del mese precedente.

item.title: JPMorgan expands corporate banking business to Greece
item.description: JPMorgan has expanded its corporate banking business to Greece, the U.S. bank said on Wednesday, as part of a broader plan to grow its services for companies across Europe.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: JPMorgan (JPM.N) has expanded its corporate banking business to Greece, the U.S. bank said on Wednesday, as part of a broader plan to grow its services for companies across Europe. JPMorgan has increased staff in its global corporate banking division by 25% across Europe, the Middle East and Africa in the last two years, and said the latest move reflected recent growth in the Greek economy. Konstantinos Makrydakis will lead the corporate banking business in Greece, serving large and medium-sized companies, the bank said. The bank will offer its array of financing, lending and hedging products as well as target investment banking deals in the country. JPMorgan is seeking to [USN:L6N43G0OM TEXT:"claim market share"] from regional and domestic rivals in the region, Reuters reported in July.

item.title: 北海ブレント先物が100ドル突破、中東情勢緊迫で供給懸念
item.description:
[シンガポール ９日 ロイター] - ９日アジア時間の取引で、北海ブレント先物が上昇し、７月２４日以来初めて１バレル＝１００ドルを上回った。中東で戦闘が激化し、原油供給への懸念が強まった。
０７２１
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[シンガポール ９日 ロイター] - ９日アジア時間の取引で、北海ブレント先物が上昇し、７月２４日以来初めて１バレル＝１００ドルを上回った。中東で戦闘が激化し、原油供給への懸念が強まった。

０７２１ ＧＭＴ（日本時間午後４時２１分）時点で、北海ブレント先物は２．１５ドル（２．２％）高の１バレル＝１００．０７ドル。米ＷＴＩ先物は１．７０ドル（１．８３％）高の９４．７３ドルだった。

今週に入り、イエメンの親イラン武装組織フーシ派がサウジアラビアのエネルギー施設を攻撃して火災が発生した。紛争が大幅に拡大する恐れが出ている。

ゴールドマン・サックス、バンク・オブ・アメリカ、ＨＳＢＣなど、原油価格の見通しを引き上げる金融機関がここ数日、相次いでいる。

ライスタッド・エナジーのチーフエコノミスト、クラウディオ・ガリンベルティ氏によると、８月３０日の戦闘再開に先立つ１週間には、ホルムズ海峡を日量約８００万─９００万バレルの原油が通過したが、直近では日量２００万バレルを下回った。

item.title: Oltre 100 dollari, conflitto in Medio Oriente si intensifica
item.description: I futures sul Brent hanno superato i 100 dollari il barile, toccando il picco delle ultime sei settimane e superando questa soglia simbolica per la prima volta dal 24 luglio. Il contributo principale è dato dall'escalation della guerra in Medio Oriente, che ha acuito i timori sulle forniture di petrolio provenienti dalla regione.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: I futures sul Brent hanno superato i 100 dollari il barile, toccando il picco delle ultime sei settimane e superando questa soglia simbolica per la prima volta dal 24 luglio. Il contributo principale è dato dall'escalation della guerra in Medio Oriente, che ha acuito i timori sulle forniture di petrolio provenienti dalla regione. ** I futures sul Brent sono in rialzo dell'1,81% a 99,65 dollari il barile alle 10.40, dopo aver toccato i 100,19 dollari, mentre il West Texas Intermediate avanza dell’1,35%, a 94,39 dollari. ** I prezzi del Brent sono aumentati di un quarto dall’inizio del mese scorso, mentre si affievoliscono le speranze di una risoluzione definitiva del conflitto tra Stati Uniti e Iran, che si trascina ormai da sei mesi. ** Da quando è iniziata la guerra con l’Iran il 28 febbraio, il Brent ha toccato un massimo di 126,41 dollari il 30 aprile scorso. ** Questa settimana gli Houthi, allineati con l’Iran, hanno attaccato alcuni impianti energetici sauditi, dando fuoco a strutture petrolifere e minacciando un'espansione significativa del conflitto. ** Negli ultimi giorni diversi istituti bancari, tra cui Goldman Sachs, Bank of America e Hsbc, hanno rivisto al rialzo le proprie previsioni sul prezzo del greggio.

item.title: Samsung Electronics Chairman Lee to buy 1.9 trillion won worth of shares from his mother
item.description: Samsung Electronics Chairman Jay Y. Lee will buy 1.9 trillion won worth of shares in the company from his mother, Hong Ra-hee, Lee said in a company filing on Wednesday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Samsung Electronics (005930.KS) Chairman Jay Y. Lee will buy 1.9 trillion won worth of shares in the company from his mother, Hong Ra-hee, Lee said in a company filing on Wednesday. He will buy the shares on October 12, according to the filing.

item.title: Negativa in avvio, pesano timori Medio Oriente, in netto calo Webuild
item.description: Indici deboli in avvio di seduta a Piazza Affari allineati all'andamento degli altri mercati europei.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Indici deboli in avvio di seduta a Piazza Affari allineati all'andamento degli altri mercati europei. Poche mosse anche le borse asiatiche e negativi i mercati Usa ieri. Il Brent ha toccato nuovamente la soglia dei 100 dollari al barile, un livello visto l'ultima volta alla fine di luglio, mentre la ripresa dei combattimenti in Medio Oriente alimenta i timori che il conflitto possa trasformarsi in una guerra regionale più ampia. Tutto questo scoraggia gli investitori a entrare sui mercati azionari, sottolinea un trader. Intorno alle 10 l'indice Ftse Mib (.FTMIB) arretra dello 0,46%. Negative le banche con l'indice settoriale che arretra dell'1,1%, trainate dal ribasso di UNICREDIT (CRDI.MI) che perde il 2%. In netto ribasso WEBUILD (WBD.MI) in flessione del 6%. Secondo un trader a causare il forte ribasso è un articolo de Il Fatto secondo cui i vertici della società delle costruzioni hanno inviato a fine luglio una lettera al governo, evidenziando costi aggiuntivi per oltre 20 miliardi di euro sulle opere infrastrutturali, chiedendo al governo di coprirli. Il broker Equita scrive nel daily che "queste indicazioni sarebbero particolarmente rilevanti per il profilo finanziario di Webuild e solleverebbero interrogativi sulla sostenibilità della generazione di cassa attesa del gruppo, considerata l'importanza del mercato italiano". Il balzo del greggio alimenta i rialzi dei titoli del comparto oil, con ENI (ENI.MI) che segna un rialzo dell'1,4%, mentre SAIPEM (SPMI.MI) cede l'1% circa. Denaro sul comparto dei cicli, con FERRARI (RACE.MI) in salita dell'1,7% e STELLANTIS (STLAM.MI) a +0,6%. Dopo il rialzo di ieri a seguito dell'incremento della componente cash dell'offerta da parte di POSTE ITALIANE (PST.MI) , oggi TIM (TLIT.MI) ripiega e cede l'1,3% a 7,59 euro, poco sotto il valore implicito dell'offerta. Fuori dal listino principale THE ITALIAN SEA GROUP (TISGR.MI) corre anche oggi a +2% dopo che anche il ceo di FERRETTI ha confermato l'interesse a rilevare asset del gruppo.

item.title: In calo, Brent a 100 dlr, conflitto Medio Oriente accende timori inflazione
item.description: I titoli europei sono in leggero calo in attesa dei dati sull’inflazione negli Stati Uniti, mentre il Brent si porta a ridosso dei 100 dollari il barile a causa delle rinnovate tensioni in Medio Oriente, che alimentano i timori di inflazione e frenano la propensione al rischio.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: I titoli europei sono in leggero calo in attesa dei dati sull’inflazione negli Stati Uniti, mentre il Brent si porta a ridosso dei 100 dollari il barile a causa delle rinnovate tensioni in Medio Oriente, che alimentano i timori di inflazione e frenano la propensione al rischio. ** L'indice paneuropeo Stoxx 600 (.STOXX) è in calo dello 0,44% a 646,75 punti, alle 9.40. Il DAX tedesco (.GDAXI) perde lo 0,51%, il FTSE di Londra (.FTSE) cede lo 0,16% e il CAC 40 francese (.FCHI) scende dello 0,62%. ** Il conflitto in Medio Oriente si è inasprito questa settimana dopo che gli Houthi yemeniti, sostenuti dall’Iran, hanno sferrato attacchi contro diverse città saudite, coinvolgendo un alleato chiave degli Stati Uniti ancora di più nel conflitto. Gli ultimi attacchi minacciano di aggravare le interruzioni delle forniture petrolifere dal Medio Oriente, già messe sotto pressione dagli attacchi alle infrastrutture energetiche regionali e alle principali rotte marittime. ** I titoli del settore energetico (.SXEP) guadagnano l’1,07%, mentre i prezzi del Brent si attestano vicino ai 100 dollari, un livello visto l'ultima volta alla fine di luglio. ** L’impennata dei prezzi del greggio riaccende i timori inflazionistici, rafforzando le aspettative secondo cui le banche centrali potrebbero dover mantenere una politica monetaria più restrittiva più a lungo. ** Secondo i dati raccolti da Lseg, gli operatori si aspettano ampiamente che la Bce alzi i tassi domani, in attesa dei dati sull’inflazione statunitense che potrebbero influenzare i mercati nel corso della settimana. ** Tra i singoli titoli, AUTO1 GROUP SE (AG1G.DE) perde il 4,78% dopo che Christian Wallentin si è dimesso dalla carica di direttore finanziario della piattaforma tedesca di vendita online di auto usate.

item.title: UK eases rules to support Openreach copper network switch-off from 2029
item.description: BT-owned broadband provider Openreach can begin raising wholesale prices for its copper connections from April 2029, British communications regulator Ofcom said on Wednesday as it sets out next steps for retiring the firm's ageing copper network.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: BT-owned (BT.L) broadband provider Openreach can begin raising wholesale prices for its copper connections from April 2029, British communications regulator Ofcom said on Wednesday as it sets out next steps for retiring the firm's ageing copper network. The move gives Openreach greater flexibility to encourage customers onto full-fibre networks as Britain transitions away from legacy copper-based broadband services, with fibre deployment nearing completion across much of the country. Ofcom said Openreach would only be permitted to raise wholesale copper broadband prices in areas where full-fibre services are available and ultra-fast broadband coverage exceeds 90% of premises, while retaining price protections for customers who cannot yet access fibre. Customers remain protected through existing charge controls where full-fibre services are not yet available, the regulator said.

item.title: Lufthansa-Gruppe fliegt ab Ende Oktober wieder nach Dubai
item.description: Die Fluggesellschaften der Lufthansa-Gruppe nehmen ihre Verbindungen nach Dubai ab Ende Oktober schrittweise wieder auf. In der Spitze sollen künftig bis zu 36 wöchentliche Flüge in die Vereinigten Arabischen Emirate angeboten werden, teilte der Konzern am Mittwoch mit. Den Anfang macht die Kernmarke Lufthansa am 25. Oktober mit fünf wöchentlichen Verbindungen von München. Einen Tag später folgt die Strecke ab Frankfurt. Auch die Töchter Swiss und Austrian Airlines nehmen ihre Flüge ab Zürich und Wien wieder auf. Eurowings fliegt das Emirat ab November von Berlin, Stuttgart und Köln/Bonn an.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Die Fluggesellschaften der Lufthansa (LHAG.DE) -Gruppe nehmen ihre Verbindungen nach Dubai ab Ende Oktober schrittweise wieder auf. In der Spitze sollen künftig bis zu 36 wöchentliche Flüge in die Vereinigten Arabischen Emirate angeboten werden, teilte der Konzern am Mittwoch mit. Den Anfang macht die Kernmarke Lufthansa am 25. Oktober mit fünf wöchentlichen Verbindungen von München. Einen Tag später folgt die Strecke ab Frankfurt. Auch die Töchter Swiss und Austrian Airlines nehmen ihre Flüge ab Zürich und Wien wieder auf. Eurowings fliegt das Emirat ab November von Berlin, Stuttgart und Köln/Bonn an. Mit der Rückkehr nach Dubai baut der Lufthansa-Konzern sein Angebot im Nahen Osten wieder aus. Die Sicherheitslage in der Region werde weiterhin fortlaufend und in enger Abstimmung mit den zuständigen Behörden bewertet, hieß es.

item.title: HSBC wickelt Sparte in Deutschland ab - Über 300 Jobs fallen weg
item.description: Die britische Großbank HSBC wickelt Geschäftsbereiche in Deutschland ab und streicht damit mehr als 300 Arbeitsplätze. Der Stellenabbau sei bis 2028 geplant und solle sozialverträglich erfolgen, teilte das Geldhaus am Mittwoch mit. Für die Kunden ergäben sich keine unmittelbaren Veränderungen. Bei den Sparten handle es sich um die Tochtergesellschaften, welche Dienstleistungen rund um die Wertpapierabwicklung anböten.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Die britische Großbank HSBC (HSBA.L) wickelt Geschäftsbereiche in Deutschland ab und streicht damit mehr als 300 Arbeitsplätze. Der Stellenabbau sei bis 2028 geplant und solle sozialverträglich erfolgen, teilte das Geldhaus am Mittwoch mit. Für die Kunden ergäben sich keine unmittelbaren Veränderungen. Bei den Sparten handle es sich um die Tochtergesellschaften, welche Dienstleistungen rund um die Wertpapierabwicklung anböten. Der Schritt stehe im Zusammenhang mit dem Verkauf des Geschäfts mit Privatkunden an BNP Paribas im Jahr 2024 und dem Verkauf des Verwahrstellengeschäfts 2025, erklärte ein Sprecher weiter. HSBC hat sich in den vergangenen Jahren stark auf das Asiengeschäft ausgerichtet.

item.title: Merz: AfD setzt auf Destabilisierung und "ethnische Säuberung"
item.description: Bundeskanzler Friedrich Merz hat der AfD eine bewusste Destabilisierung Deutschlands und die Vertretung russischer Interessen vorgeworfen. Zudem warf er der Partei in der Generaldebatte im Bundestag am Mittwoch vor, dass ihr Konzept der Remigration "nichts anderes ist als eine ethnische Säuberung nach Herkunft und Hautfarbe". Der Kanzler verwies auf Millionen Beschäftigte mit Migrationshintergrund etwa im Handwerk oder Pflegeberufen.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Bundeskanzler Friedrich Merz hat der AfD eine bewusste Destabilisierung Deutschlands und die Vertretung russischer Interessen vorgeworfen. Zudem warf er der Partei in der Generaldebatte im Bundestag am Mittwoch vor, dass ihr Konzept der Remigration "nichts anderes ist als eine ethnische Säuberung nach Herkunft und Hautfarbe". Der Kanzler verwies auf Millionen Beschäftigte mit Migrationshintergrund etwa im Handwerk oder Pflegeberufen. "Sie wollen unser Land destabilisieren", warf er vor allem der AfD-Co-Vorsitzenden Alice Weidel vor, die ihn zuvor persönlich angegriffen hatte. "Ihre ganze Missachtung vor dem Deutschen Bundestag kommt auch in diesem Verhalten hier zum Ausdruck", sagte er zu den zahlreichen Zwischenrufen aus der AfD-Fraktion während seiner Rede. Die AfD wolle die Institutionen in Deutschland verächtlich machen. Merz verwies in seiner Rede auf die Reformpolitik der schwarz-roten Regierung, verzichtete aber darauf, den Koalitionspartner SPD wegen der Wünsche nach Nachbesserungen zu ermahnen.

item.title: Merz: Gasversorgung im Winter ist sicher
item.description: Bundeskanzler Friedrich Merz hat betont, dass die Gasversorgung in Deutschland im Winter sicher sei. "Wir haben selbstverständlich den Füllstand bei Speichern im Blick", sagte Merz am Mittwoch im Bundestag in der Generaldebatte zum Haushalt 2027. "Gehen Sie davon aus, dass die Bundeswirtschaftsministerin in Absprache mit den Mitgliedern der Bundesregierung genau das Richtige tut, um die Gasversorgung im Winter sicherzustellen." Der AfD warf er vor, mit den Warnungen vor zu leeren Speichern "hektische Kaufaktionen öffentlich auszulösen", die nur dazu führten, dass die Preise an den Gasmärkten sehr stark stiegen.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Bundeskanzler Friedrich Merz hat betont, dass die Gasversorgung in Deutschland im Winter sicher sei. "Wir haben selbstverständlich den Füllstand bei Speichern im Blick", sagte Merz am Mittwoch im Bundestag in der Generaldebatte zum Haushalt 2027. "Gehen Sie davon aus, dass die Bundeswirtschaftsministerin in Absprache mit den Mitgliedern der Bundesregierung genau das Richtige tut, um die Gasversorgung im Winter sicherzustellen." Der AfD warf er vor, mit den Warnungen vor zu leeren Speichern "hektische Kaufaktionen öffentlich auszulösen", die nur dazu führten, dass die Preise an den Gasmärkten sehr stark stiegen. Dies würde nicht nur die öffentlichen Haushalte, sondern die Verbraucherinnen und Verbraucher in Deutschland treffen, warnte Merz. "Wir bekommen klare Hinweise darauf, dass die Energieversorgung, dass insbesondere die Gasversorgung im Laufe des Winters in Deutschland gesichert ist, und genau darauf baut die Bundesregierung auch ihre Versorgungsstrategie auf." Zuvor hatte der Gasspeicher-Verband Ines wegen [USN:L8N4501OI TEXT:"historisch leerer Gasspeicher"] vor Engpässen im Fall eines sehr kalten Winters gewarnt. Die Speicher seien Anfang September nur zu rund 53 Prozent gefüllt. Dies sei der niedrigste Stand zu diesem Zeitpunkt seit Beginn der Aufzeichnungen vor 15 Jahren.

item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Die AfD dringt nach dem Sieg bei der Landtagswahl in Sachsen-Anhalt auf einen Politikwechsel im Bund. Das Signal sei eindeutig: "Schwarz-Rot ist vorbei", sagte AfD-Co-Chefin Alice Weidel am Mittwoch bei der Generaldebatte im Bundestag. Kanzler und CDU-Chef Friedrich Merz habe die Botschaft nicht verstanden, was aber nicht weiter relevant sei. "Ihre Zeit ist ohnehin abgelaufen." Die Bürger wollten einen Politikwechsel. Die AfD werde dafür beim nächsten Mal einen klaren Regierungsauftrag im Bund bekommen. "Und wir werden diesen Auftrag ernst, und wir werden ihn annehmen." Die CDU sei dagegen auf dem Weg zu einer Kleinstpartei. Die AfD hatte am Sonntag die Landtagswahl in Sachsen-Anhalt mit großem Abstand gewonnen und ihr Ergebnis auf 43,8 Prozent mehr als verdoppelt, während sich die CDU mehr als halbierte und nur noch 17,2 Prozent erhielt. Zum regieren braucht die AfD aber einen Partner. Eine Mehrheit könnte sie zusammen mit dem BSW oder mit mehreren Überläufern aus der CDU bekommen. Weidel kritisierte einen aus ihrer Sicht verfassungswidrigen Haushaltsentwurf für 2027, den Finanzminister und SPD-Chef Lars Klingbeil am Dienstag ins Parlament eingebracht hatte. Trotz Rekord-Steuereinnahmen komme die Regierung aus Union und SPD nicht ohne riesige Schulden aus, mehr als 1000 Milliarden Euro seien in der Amtszeit der Bundesregierung geplant, was beispiellos sei. Dadurch würden die politischen Spielräume stark eingeengt. Merz treibe Deutschland in die Staatspleite. Weidel betonte, die Energiewende sei gescheitert und bringe viel zu hohe Kosten für die Wirtschaft. Zudem steuere die Regierung angesichts der niedrigen Füllstände der Gasspeicher auf eine "existenzielle Gasversorgungskrise" im Winter zu. Deutschland brauche wieder günstiges Gas aus Russland und auch eigene Atomkraftwerke. Auch müssten Subventionen für Klimaschutz und Entwicklungshilfe gestrichen werden, forderte sie.

item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Die Stahlindustrie in Deutschland hat im Juli erstmals in diesem Jahr wieder weniger produziert. Die anhaltend schwache Nachfrage habe zu einem Rückgang der Rohstahlproduktion gegenüber dem Vorjahresmonat um rund zwei Prozent auf knapp 2,7 Millionen Tonnen geführt, teilte die Wirtschaftsvereinigung Stahl am Mittwoch mit. Von Januar bis Juli 2026 stehe noch ein Plus von fast sieben Prozent in den Büchern. Die Schwerindustrie mit Playern wie Thyssenkrupp (TKAG.DE) Steel Europe (TKSE), Salzgitter (SZGG.DE) und ArcelorMittal (MT.LU) kämpft seit Jahren unter anderem mit hohen Energiepreisen, Überkapazitäten und der Konkurrenz aus Fernost. Der deutsche Branchenführer TKSE hat angekündigt, in den kommenden Jahren bis zu 11.000 seiner rund 26.000 Arbeitsplätze zu streichen oder auszulagern.

item.title: モルドバとの国境検問所に無人機攻撃、2人死亡＝ウクライナ当局
item.description: [９日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[９日 ロイター] - ウクライナ当局は９日、ロシアのドローン（無人機）が南部オデーサ州にあるモルドバとの国境検問所を攻撃し、２人が死亡したほか、夜間に首都キーウも攻撃されたと明らかにした。

同州のキペル知事はテレグラムを通じ、スタロコザチェ国境検問所付近で民間人２人が死亡、３人が負傷したと述べた。

当局によると、この攻撃により大規模な火災が発生し、国境の通行は一時的に停止された。

また、ロシアは夜間にキーウも攻撃し、火災を引き起こしたが、死傷者は出なかったと、緊急事態対応機関がテレグラム投稿で明らかにした。

item.title: Anglo-Teck wait shows mining M&A’s rising toll
item.description: A year after Anglo American's $54 bln merger with its Canadian rival the pair are still waiting for Chinese approval. Antitrust issues are minimal and investors remain confident, but Beijing has extracted concessions before. Mining megadeals are becoming costlier everywhere.
item.dc:creator: Yawen Chen
item.content:encoded: Copper has never been more valuable. That makes owning more of it both attractive and politically awkward. It may also help explain why Anglo American (AAL.L) and Teck Resources (TECKb.TO) are still waiting for Chinese approval for their $54 billion merger a year after announcing it. The cost of mining megadeals is going up. Copper [USN:L6N45002P TEXT:"hit a record"] on Tuesday, rising above $14,700 a tonne, as tight supply, strong demand from power grids and electric vehicles, and expectations of U.S. tariffs on refined imports pushed prices higher. The rally is an [USN:L6N3UW0DT TEXT:"endorsement of the Anglo-Teck deal"]: combining the pair would create a miner with some of the industry’s most coveted growth projects focused on the red metal. Yet one important signature is still missing. China is the last major jurisdiction yet to approve the transaction, and financial news service Mergermarket reported last week that Beijing had suspended its review clock. The People's Republic typically gives the State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR) up to 180 days to vet a merger, but the regulator can stop the countdown while seeking information or considering remedies. The deal is not an obvious target for competition regulators. The combined Anglo-Teck would have 5% of global copper output, based on 2024 figures. Investors seem confident the merger will go ahead. Teck trades just 1.3% below the value implied by Anglo's proposed share swap, after adjusting for the South African group's roughly $4.5 billion special dividend, Breakingviews calculates. Yet Beijing has a track record of extracting concessions. In 2013, Chinese regulators required Glencore (GLEN.L) to sell its Las Bambas copper project in Peru as a condition for approving the miner's takeover of rival Xstrata. A Chinese-led consortium later bought the asset for $5.85 billion. Teck has few obvious assets to sacrifice, while its best copper mines are precisely what makes the merger with Anglo attractive. Still, the pair could offer other goodies, like supply guarantees or purchase agreements. China may also be seeking preferential treatment of its companies overseas, at a time when countries such as [USN:L1N3IX01E TEXT:"Canada"] are making it harder for Chinese investors to buy strategic mineral assets and have even ordered some existing holdings to be sold. Chinese authorities are hardly alone in scrutinising commodity supply chains. European Union regulators are preparing to warn China-controlled MMG (1208.HK) over its purchase of Anglo’s Brazilian nickel business, Reuters [USN:L1N44W0Q3 TEXT:"reported"] on Tuesday citing sources, partly because of concerns that ferronickel supply could be diverted from Europe. That is a much smaller transaction, but it illustrates the complex geometry of mining deals: selling an asset or making a concession to satisfy one government can raise strategic or competition concerns with another. As prized standalone mines become harder to buy, miners have turned to acquiring rival companies, just as governments are attaching more importance to national security and supply resilience. That may not stop mining [USN:L6N3VI0LH TEXT:"megadeals"] like Anglo-Teck, but it is likely to slow them down - and ultimately make them more expensive. Follow Yawen Chen on Bluesky and LinkedIn . EU regulators are preparing to warn Hong Kong-listed mining and metals company MMG over its plan to buy Anglo American's Brazilian nickel business because of competition concerns, Reuters reported on September 8, citing three people familiar with the matter. China’s review for Anglo American's proposed acquisition of Teck Resources remains suspended, Mergermarket reported on September 1. “We are not going to provide a running commentary but we are working with the State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR) through its normal process and, as we have said all along, this transaction is positive for supply growth and therefore also for our customers,” Anglo American told Reuters Breakingviews on September 7. Teck told Reuters Breakingviews the company does not comment on regulatory processes. Anglo American has previously said it expects the Teck merger to close between September 2026 and March 2027.
